purpose: Re-regression-test after patching generate_witnesses.cpp with a salvage pass (see the POST-HOC PATCH comment in the file itself). The first real Z_61 sizes 56-60 run left exactly 2 of 8738 representatives unresolved (0x7ffffffffffffff size 59, 0xfffffffffffffff size 60 -- see generator-progress.log, exit code 3, no certificate written that run). Root cause: find_witness()'s unit-scaling fallback is degenerate for any mask with a size-1 multiplicative orbit (a fixed point of scaling -- the full set Z_61\{0} is always such a fixed point), so it silently repeated an identical deterministic search up to 59 times instead of actually diversifying. Fix: threaded an explicit `salt` parameter through greedy_search/anneal_search (default 0, a no-op XOR against both RNG seed formulas) and added a 96-round salted salvage pass to find_witness(), reached only when both original phases fail. This regression re-run exists to confirm the patch is truly inert for every path that previously worked -- Z_29 sizes 21-28 never needed the salvage pass even before this patch, so its output must remain byte-identical.
method: Recompiled generate_witnesses_z29regress from the PATCHED generate_witnesses.cpp source with -DPRIME=29 -DMIN_K_DEFAULT=21 -DMAX_K_DEFAULT=28, ran fresh into a new scratch path, diffed byte-for-byte against the already-committed graham-z29 witnesses.tsv, and re-ran both verifiers.
note: greedyTrials/greedyNodes/annealRestarts/annealSteps are IDENTICAL to the pre-patch regression run (1904057/36245840/4/117621) -- direct confirmation that not a single Z_29 mask in sizes 21-28 ever reached the new salvage pass (the pass increments the anneal_restarts stat when entered, and that stat did not change), i.e. the patch is fully inert on this known-good path, not just coincidentally hash-identical.
conclusion: Patch confirmed inert on the already-proven Z_29 sizes 21-28 path: byte-identical certificate, byte-identical search-effort stats, both verifiers still VERIFIED. Proceeding to re-run the real Z_61 sizes 56-60 generation with the patched binary.
